requirements.quote: 1. The format of all Control Packets that the Client sends matches the format described in Chapter 2 and Chapter 3.
requirements.condition: Whenever the Client sends an MQTT Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the packet in the format described by Chapters 2 and 3.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send a packet whose format conflicts with those chapters.
requirements.why_checkable: This is an aggregate cross-reference rather than an atomic format rule; the referenced field layouts and packet-specific checks are not present in this chunk, so it cannot define a standalone atomic test here.
